decisions.reason: Although carpets have been selectively pruned, this hand-knotted wool silk carpet still matches the firm's material and craftsmanship knowledge well enough that management would keep learning from its premium niche rather than withdraw it now.

The corner bench sits squarely within the firm's core furniture and project-interior capabilities, so accumulated market feedback can be readily absorbed and used to refine sales and applications instead of dropping it.

The swivel shell chair line is highly related to the firm's established seating expertise across residential and contract settings, and the multi-model range gives strong scope to adapt the offer through learning rather than exit the line.
